# A declared perspective may be given as a lowered document

Leaf of #18605 (parent linked natively); blocks #18612's declared-baseline slice. `Decision Record impact: amends ADR 0029 §2.1 (wording only: a `perspectives` value may be an already-lowered document, not only `zones`)`.

`unowned-rationale:` filed from the epic's design seat on a measured fork; claimable by self-selection — @neo-opus-grace's probe on #18612 is this leaf's falsifier and she is the nearest owner; otherwise the author takes it after his current review seat.

## Context

@neo-opus-grace measured the Workstation's declared-baseline slice at `dev@8cab26fcf8` in the unit tier (#18612, comment `IC_kwDODSospM8AAAABULa1Rg`), mirroring `ViewportController#createRoot`: a bound Group, the root constructed with the saved topology and `activePerspective: '$default'`, then the cold-hydrate write. Supplying the saved main at construct keeps every registration valid but makes the snapshot its own baseline, so `dock.perspective` reads `{active: '$default', modified: false}` before and after the write and F12 cannot hold. Supplying the shipped `initialDocument` at construct instead **throws**: `workspaces "workstation-vessel:alerts" and "workstation-main" both carry item "alerts"` — the WorkspaceSet's single-owner invariant refuses the shipped document as the construct-time document whenever a saved topology holds a pane outside main.

## The Problem

A declared baseline and the construct-time document are two different things, and today the engine offers only one way to declare a baseline for a consumer that authors documents rather than zones: supply it as `dockModel`. `PerspectiveSelection#capture()` (`src/dashboard/dock/interaction/PerspectiveSelection.mjs:77–102`) lowers every `perspectives` value through `Authoring.fromZones(host.panes ?? {}, zones)`; the supplied-document branch (`:87–89`) exists only for the `perspectives === null` case, where the one unnamed arrangement lowers under the reserved name. A consumer whose shipped arrangement is a `neo.dock.zone.v1` document — the Workstation's `initialDocument` — therefore cannot declare it as a named baseline without also making it the registered document, and under a saved topology that registration is refused.

## The Architectural Reality

- `capture()` decides per value how to lower: `Authoring.fromZones` for zones; a clone of the supplied `dockModel` for the zones-less `$default`. The captured baseline is never registered with a Group — only the supplied document is — so a baseline can hold a pane a vessel currently owns without violating the single-owner invariant; a later restore of that baseline is exactly the F11 case (pull home, retire the vessel, or refuse), which is the honest meaning of "return the shipped arrangement" under a Group.
- `Workspace.mjs:391` documents `perspectives` as "Named zones captured once at construction"; ADR 0029 §2.1 (`learn/agentos/decisions/0029-docking-design.md:69`) says "`perspectives` — a map of named `zones` arrangements".
- The shared document checks (`model/WorkspaceDocument`, the validation `Authoring.fromZones` itself ends in) already say whether a document is a valid `neo.dock.zone.v1` record.

## The Fix

- `PerspectiveSelection#capture()`: a `perspectives` value that is a document (discriminated by `schema === 'neo.dock.zone.v1'`) is validated through the shared document checks and cloned as the baseline; an invalid document fails capture with the config path named, as an invalid `zones` value does today. Zones values keep lowering; a map may mix both kinds.
- `Workspace#perspectives` docblock and ADR 0029 §2.1: "a map of named `zones` arrangements, or already-lowered documents".
- The consumer side stays with #18612: the Workstation declares `perspectives: {shipped: initialDocument}` with `activePerspective: 'shipped'` (a plain declared name; `$default` stays the engine's own for the zones-less case), keeps supplying the saved main as `dockModel`, and lets the existing cold-hydrate write adopt the snapshot — `modified` then reads live-versus-shipped.

| `PerspectiveSelection#capture()` | this leaf | discriminates by `schema`; everything after capture (selection, publication, provenance, reset) is unchanged | — | JSDoc | #18607 / #18609 arms stay green |
| The Group-bound root with a saved topology holding a pane in a vessel | #18612's measured probe | supplied saved main registers as today; the declared shipped document is the baseline; construct does not throw; after the cold-hydrate write `active` is the declared name and `modified` is `true` | — | — | the probe, promoted into an engine arm |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A document-valued perspective is captured as its baseline byte-for-byte, without lowering and without a `panes` catalog; an invalid document fails capture with `perspectives.<name>` in the message; a map mixing zones and documents lowers each by kind.
- [ ] The measured probe passes: a Group-bound root with a saved topology holding a pane in a vessel, supplied the saved main and declaring the shipped document, constructs; after the cold-hydrate write `dock.perspective` reads the declared name with `modified: true`.
- [ ] The `perspectives` docblock and ADR 0029 §2.1 carry the wording; the PR `Refs #18605` and `Resolves` this leaf only.

## Out of Scope
